# Contributing

## Setup

Use Node.js 20 or newer and install the package before working.

## Tests

Run `npm test` to run all tests.
Run `npm run lint` before opening a pull request.

## Commits

Use a conventional message such as `fix(parser): handle bad input`.
Useful types include `fix`, `docs`, and `test`.

## Pull requests

Open a branch and target `main`.
The test and lint checks should be green.
Keep the description short and ask for review.

## Generated files

Generated files are in `src/generated/`.
Update them when the command list changes.

## Releases

Release the package from the release branch and use tags like `release-<version>`.

Please be respectful and keep changes focused.
